title: DB Infrastructure (base.py + session.py + alembic env.py)
scope: Three tightly-coupled files: (a) DeclarativeBase + TimestampMixin; (b) engine + SessionLocal + get_db dependency; (c) alembic env that wires sqlalchemy.url=settings.database_url and target_metadata=Base.metadata. env.py MUST import all ORM model modules so Base.metadata sees them — even though T-004 hasn't run yet, env.py uses a try/except guard so the file is importable before models exist.

success_criteria.manual: (a) `python -c 'from src.infrastructure.db.base import Base; from src.infrastructure.db.session import engine, SessionLocal, get_db; print("ok")'` → 'ok'. (b) `cd backend && alembic check` → exits 0.
success_criteria.automated: No dedicated unit test; T-005 BaseRepository tests use SessionLocal via T-009 conftest.
success_criteria.definition_of_done: Three files import cleanly; alembic CLI recognises env.py.

checkout_prompt: On completion, return: 'DB infrastructure trio created — Base + TimestampMixin, engine + SessionLocal + get_db, alembic env.py wired to Base.metadata. MIGRATION-001 resolved.'
